input: Book a stand-up paddleboarding lesson this summer

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether this is a single intro lesson, a multi-session course, or a private vs. group lesson changes what to search for and budget expectations entirely.
Whether the user is booking solo, with a partner, family, or friends affects which lesson formats are suitable and how many spots need to be reserved.
The specific location (coast, lake, river, local area) determines which providers are even available and what conditions to expect.
A budget ceiling rules out premium providers or private instruction; knowing it focuses the search immediately.
The user's prior experience level (complete beginner vs. some experience) changes the type of lesson needed and what skills to prioritise.
Knowing which months or weeks in summer are available narrows the booking window and urgency of acting now vs. later.
Understanding what the user wants to walk away with (basic balance, surfing waves, fitness routine, fun day out) shapes which instructor or school is the best fit.

gold.taskTitle: Book a stand-up paddleboarding lesson this summer
gold.taskDescription: Find and book a stand-up paddleboarding lesson for the user at some point during the summer.

questions.title: Is this one lesson or a multi-session course?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants a single introductory lesson or a structured course spanning multiple sessions, as this changes the type of provider and total commitment needed.

questions.title: Are you booking just for yourself or a group?
questions.description: Establish how many people need spots — solo, a pair, or a larger group — since this affects whether a private or group lesson is more practical and cost-effective.

questions.title: What location or body of water do you have in mind?
questions.description: Identify the geographic area (e.g., a specific coastline, lake, or city) so the search for providers is relevant and feasible.

questions.title: What is your budget per person for the lesson?
questions.description: Establish a rough spending limit to filter out providers that are too expensive and focus on realistic options.

questions.title: How would you describe your current paddleboarding experience?
questions.description: Find out if the user is a complete beginner or has some prior time on the board, which determines the lesson level and what skills the instructor should cover.

questions.title: Which months or weeks this summer are you free?
questions.description: Pin down the available window within summer to gauge booking urgency and filter providers by availability.

questions.title: What do you most want to be able to do after the lesson?
questions.description: Clarify the user's end goal — such as confidently standing and paddling, riding small waves, or simply having a fun experience — to match them with the right instructor focus.
